county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.

Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies
